exposure: delivery of first twin before 22 weeks of gestation
placement of cerclage after delivery of first twin
cohort: The study included 17 cases of delayed-interval deliveries in multiple pregnancies from 2003 to 2020 at the Women's and Children's Hospital of the University Hospital Ulm.
finding: Delayed-interval delivery in multiple pregnancies with extremely preterm birth of the first twin is feasible and safe, achieving an average prolongation of 36 days without serious maternal morbidity or additional fetal complications, and resulting in short- and long-term outcomes for the second twin comparable to age-matched controls.
followup_time: Long-term outcome was assessed, but no specific duration was mentioned.
gest_age: Extremely preterm birth of the first twin; specifically, delivery of the first twin before 22 weeks of gestation and after 22 weeks of gestation were analyzed.
